scenes.text: Above, one stem appears. Below, roots keep choosing darkness in a hundred directions.
scenes.query: a green stem above soil with an intricate network of roots branching through dark glass chambers

scenes.text: A decision selects my experience, while rejected possibilities may continue as probable lives.
scenes.query: a hand selecting one photograph while many photographs develop themselves in separate trays

scenes.text: The call I avoid may become a door another version of me still opens.
scenes.query: an unanswered telephone beside a closed apartment door whose shadow opens into another home

scenes.text: I experience one answer because attention is a flashlight, not because the house vanished.
scenes.query: a flashlight illuminating one furnished room while many connected rooms remain visible in blue darkness

scenes.text: Those selves are not failed drafts. They are sentences written from the same first word.
scenes.query: a typewriter producing several pages that continue writing different stories across one long desk

scenes.text: I may feel them as familiarity, a fingerprinted dream, or grief for an unlived life.
scenes.query: a bedside table holding a dream journal, an unfamiliar key, and a photograph with a blank figure

scenes.text: Time is not a river. It is rain striking many windows at once.
scenes.query: rain falling simultaneously across windows showing different seasons and different cities

scenes.text: Growth is not a ladder toward perfection. A ladder knows only one direction.
scenes.query: a narrow ladder ending at a ceiling beside a vast compass rose opening across the floor

scenes.text: That changes good and evil. I no longer picture eternal armies owning half the sky.
scenes.query: two opposing armies painted on theater curtains as the curtains are drawn aside to reveal one sky

scenes.text: Pain is not imaginary. Destruction has no separate well of life to drink from.
scenes.query: a dry black stone well beside a flowing communal spring surrounded by worn drinking cups

scenes.text: It borrows creative power, then teaches it to forget the living web.
scenes.query: a black river severing itself from a colorful living delta seen from high above

scenes.text: A shadow owns no lamp, but still covers a face. Consequences remain real.
scenes.query: a heavy moving shadow crossing a sunlit marble statue while an open lamp stands beyond it

scenes.text: Responsibility matters. Philosophy becomes an escape hatch when it refuses to kneel beside suffering.
scenes.query: an ornate golden escape hatch beside a plain figure kneeling to help someone on a stone floor

scenes.text: Religious images can map inner weather: thunder given a face, mercy given hands.
scenes.query: an old illuminated map where storm clouds become a carved face and warm rain becomes open hands

scenes.text: A devil can be terror wearing a mask; a savior, wholeness wearing a body the heart recognizes.
scenes.query: a dark ceremonial mask and a simple white garment resting on opposite sides of one dressing mirror

scenes.text: The symbol is a cup, not the water. Each century lifts a different cup.
scenes.query: cups from many historical periods arranged around one clear spring at dawn

scenes.text: Trouble begins when I worship the cup and forget I was thirsty.
scenes.query: a glass display case protecting an ornate empty cup while fresh water flows outside

scenes.text: Morality is not spotless obedience. It is power remembering nothing exists alone.
scenes.query: many separate colored threads joining into a strong bridge over a deep canyon

scenes.text: I am not responsible for every storm, only the weather my hands bring inside.
scenes.query: two hands opening curtains in a storm-dark room as clean morning light enters

scenes.text: Choice does not kill roads. It decides which road borrows my footsteps today.
scenes.query: ordinary shoes paused where several wet roads begin at sunrise, one path receiving the first footprint
